name: Rochelle Greenwood
bio: Rochelle Greenwood is a versatile Canadian actress and voice actress. Over a career spanning four decades, she has seamlessly transitioned from a prominent child actress in the late 1980s to a steady fixture in television, film, and video game voice-overs.

credits.title: Breeder
credits.overview: An eccentric poodle breeder lures a broke college student to her remote ranch with a promise of research funding. But, as he soon learns, there’s a catch.

credits.overview: A bookstore owner finds love and direction in life after agreeing to review a famous author’s new novel in her blind-date-with-a-book club.

credits.overview: Talia and her childhood best friend Anderson unexpectedly reunite in a curiously familiar looking town full of Christmas spirit that restores its visitors when they need it most.

credits.title: Rise and Shine, Benedict Stone
credits.overview: The story about Benedict Stone and his wife Emilia who got separated after 10 years, when trying for a baby becomes unsuccessful.

credits.title: Chronicle Mysteries: Vines that Bind
credits.overview: The latest edition of Alex McPherson’s true crime podcast leads her  and most of the Chronicle staff to nearby Macklin, where they  investigate the death of a vintner that was ruled an accident by the  local police.

credits.title: Madeline: Lost in Paris
credits.overview: When Madeline's long lost uncle Horst arrives to take her to a Viennese finishing school, Miss Clavel, the eleven little girls and Pepito realize that something is not right.

credits.title: Convictions
credits.overview: It has been nine years since Bancroft's character shot Brown's son. She goes to the prison to vent her rage at him over what he did, and discovers he's not the monster she thought he was.

credits.title: Deadly Intentions... Again?
credits.overview: A doctor was sent to prison for the attempted murder of his first wife. When he is released, he starts to plan the death of his second wife whom he married before he was incarcerated.

credits.title: The Stepfather
credits.overview: Seemingly mild-mannered Henry Morrison has just murdered his entire family. After adopting a new identity and skipping town, he begins building a new relationship with a widow and her teenage daughter. However, he soon begins struggling to hide his true identity and maintain a grip on reality.
